decisions.reason: Only mentioned on the website suggests early-stage uncertainty, and organisational slack allows carrying it while results are compared with aspirations.
Having its own page indicates a stronger commitment and likely closer performance to aspirations, so a lower drop probability is warranted.
Mention-only status implies uncertain results, but slack supports keeping it while management evaluates against aspirations.
